modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

pcs.pc_description: identify the equipment, its manufacturer's specifications and functioning from the user manual
enquire with the user/operator about any problems/unusual conditions noticed in the equipment
read the corrective maintenance schedule to identify tools, consumables, spare parts required during the task and prepare schedule for conducting the preventive maintenance of the equipment
use checklist and coordinate with the superior for confirming maintenance tasks

modules.module_title: Carrying out the maintenance of the equipment

pcs.pc_description: dismantle the equipment and replace/change the electrical and electronic system spare parts and consumables of equipment as per the schedule
check the internal conditions of wiring, motherboards etc. to test its working status and expected conditions

conduct breakdown maintenance and then inspect the equipment for charge leakage, short circuit in parts, breakage of wires and clamps, unusual contact of electrical wires with moving parts, erratic/problematic performance or any other problem as reported in the complaint
clean, change or repair the electrical and electronic system as per requirement
use recommended consumables, tools and equipment for service and repair of electrical and electronic systems of the equipment as per Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
assemble back the covers, guards, clamps, insulation etc. of the equipment and prepare it for conducting the trials
shift and install the equipment for the next procedure and record all repairs carried out, time taken and unplanned tasks encountered in the activity
conduct trials of the equipment by increasing duty conditions gradually and verify that specified parameters are attained with no abnormalities
run few cycles of equipment and observe its functioning in the presence of operator
change the maintenance due/status sticker on the equipment
ensure that all maintenance points are adequately considered and report the superiors (manufacturing and maintenance department) about maintenance activity done on the equipment
